title: Jones Beach Boys
subtitle: Surf Rock · Long Beach, NY
excerpt: Salt, spring reverb, and choruses built for open windows. The newest signal on the roster.
body: Jones Beach Boys join Quantum Frequency Records. A Long Island surf-rock outfit that treats summer like a religion and the boardwalk like a cathedral. Spring reverb, stacked vocals, and songs that sound like they were written with the windows down.
